day0:
Do, dream, listen, connect,
Create, move, choose,
Collect moments,
Live with habits that shape who you are,
Be in rhythm, not in a rush,
Be yourself — but every day a step closer to your better self.
day1:
Don’t hype yourself — compose yourself.
Don’t wait for the perfect moment — just start.
Check off what’s done — not for reward, but for movement.
Choose habit — not chaos.
Work with what you have. Calmly. With focus.
night0:
Sleep, restore, dream,
Let go of worries, breathe deeper,
Be silent — and hear yourself,
Let the body heal what the day couldn’t.
Let the mind slow down,
Let everything quietly fall into place.
night1:
Don’t push through. Let go.
Finish — even if not everything got done.
Go to bed not because you’re tired, but because you decided to.
Turn silence into ritual.
Respect your resource — it’s your tool.
switchOnDay: Turn on the day — to act
switchOnNight: Turn on the night — to exhale
quote0: You can do more than you think.

quote2: Don't wait for the moment — create it.
quote3: Failure is not the end, it's a lesson.
quote4: Do today what you'll thank yourself for tomorrow.
quote5: The best time to start is now.
quote6: You are the main character in your story.
quote7: One step a day is 365 steps a year.
quote9: Don't give up until you're proud.
quote10: Risk is part of the road to success.
quote11: Be persistent, even when you see no results.
quote14: Fear is the gateway to growth.
quote15: You're the only one who can do this.
quote16: Mistakes are proof that you're trying.
quote17: Courage is not the absence of fear, but action despite it.
quote18: Do it with love, or not at all.
quote20: No one knows how strong you are until you show it.
quote21: Each day is a chance to change your life.
quote22: Success is a habit, not a coincidence.
quote24: Be persistent. Even stars are born under pressure.
quote25: Laziness is temporary. Results are forever.
quote27: Is it hard? That means you're growing.
quote28: You don't have to be perfect. You have to be honest with yourself.

advice25: Chronic stress affects your heart. Take care of yourself.

joke10: My superpower is postponing important stuff in a very inspired way.
joke11: My fitness tracker counts steps to the fridge as a win.
joke12: Meditation — it’s like sleep, but science-approved.

joke17: My plan for the day: don’t forget I had a plan.

joke24: Exercise is healthy. Especially watching others do it.
joke25: Success is remembering your Wi-Fi password.

joke27: Every day feels like Monday. Except Saturday. Sometimes.

puzzleQuestion0: What are you grateful for today?
puzzleBody0: Find at least one small spark of light in the past day.
puzzleFooter0: Your bed is bored. It's time to cuddle with it.
puzzleBody1: Color reflects energy, rhythm, inner palette.
puzzleFooter1: I did what I could today. Let it end beautifully.
puzzleBody2: Find a resource that you leaned.
puzzleFooter2: The body is not a machine. It asks for silence, not YouTube.
puzzleBody3: Remember and mentally relive that moment.
puzzleFooter3: Tomorrow you will be grateful to yourself for today's sleep.
puzzleQuestion4: Imagine: a day is a line. What is it like?
puzzleBody4: Straight, wave, zigzag? Let it tell about your path.
puzzleFooter4: The Internet can wait. And your recovery isn't.
puzzleTitle5: A thought I'm letting go of
puzzleQuestion5: What do you want to let go of?
puzzleBody5: Just name it. That's enough to let go.
puzzleFooter5: The best ideas come to you when you've had enough sleep. Step into the shadows to shine again.
puzzleBody6: Acknowledge at least one action that deserves a 'bravo'.
puzzleFooter6: Silence is also music. Listen to it before bed.
puzzleQuestion7: Who were you today - an owl? A fox? turtle?
puzzleBody7: Feel your “spirit of the day” — and embrace it.
puzzleFooter7: You deserve peace. It’s near. Just close your eyes.
puzzleQuestion8: One word that describes your state of mind.
puzzleBody8: This word is the key to your inner weather.
puzzleFooter8: Turn off the lights before the day turns you off.
puzzleQuestion9: What would you call this day if it were a book?
puzzleBody9: The title helps draw the line.
puzzleFooter9: Take a break. Not everything has to be done before midnight.
puzzleQuestion10: “Thank you for carrying me through the days.”
puzzleBody10: Run your hand over your body in your mind.
puzzleFooter10: Give your eyes a break from the screen. Let them look inward.
puzzleQuestion11: Who are you hugging in your mind right now?
puzzleBody11: Even imaginary warmth changes your state.
puzzleFooter11: Tomorrow there will be another opportunity to win. Today is the time to reset.
puzzleQuestion12: Imagine a place where you are completely calm.
puzzleBody12: Linger there for a few breaths.
puzzleFooter12: You are not a robot. Sleep is fuel.
puzzleQuestion13: What was your internal weather today?
puzzleFooter13: Peace is also productivity. Don't underestimate rest.
puzzleQuestion14: What did you do that you didn't want to?
puzzleBody14: Recognize the power of moving forward.
puzzleFooter14: By turning off the day, you turn on self-care.
puzzleQuestion15: What would you like to leave in your memory?
puzzleFooter15: The world can cope without you for a couple of hours. Sleep well.
puzzleTitle16: I am part of something bigger
puzzleQuestion16: What reminded you today that you are not alone?
puzzleBody16: Being part of it is also soothing.
puzzleFooter16: Lie down. Don't scroll. Don't analyze. Lie down.
puzzleQuestion17: What can you forgive yourself today?
puzzleBody17: Understanding is the first step to lightness.
puzzleFooter17: Breathe slowly. Nothing needs to be solved anymore.
puzzleBody18: Everyone blooms otherwise. And that's good.
puzzleFooter18: Let the screen go dark. And thoughts become soft.
puzzleQuestion19: What does the silence tell you today?
puzzleBody19: Listen. The answer is there too.
puzzleFooter19: You won't miss anything important. But you might miss the morning.
puzzleQuestion20: Who do you want to send some goodness to today?
puzzleBody20: Even in your thoughts. That's enough.
puzzleFooter20: The silence of the night heals more effectively than advice.
puzzleQuestion21: What word will you start your morning with?
puzzleBody21: Let it be a small compass.
puzzleFooter21: You've done enough. That's enough. Close the day.
puzzleBody22: This is your support. Appreciate them.
puzzleFooter22: Tomorrow will be easier if you just fall asleep today.
puzzleQuestion23: Can you accept everything today as it was?
puzzleBody23: That's also a kind of strength.
puzzleFooter23: Sleep is not weakness. It's preparation for power.
puzzleQuestion24: What connects today with tomorrow morning?
puzzleBody24: Build a bridge. Even a symbolic one.
puzzleFooter24: Time to turn off your head. And turn on the pillow.
puzzleQuestion25: In what gesture, thought, or word did life beat today?
puzzleBody25: This was your pulse of the day.
puzzleFooter25: Do you want to be strong tomorrow? Lie down today.
puzzleQuestion26: When did you feel a connection with others today?
puzzleBody26: Even if not physically — you are part of something.
puzzleFooter26: Rhythm is not a prison. It's your anchor.
puzzleQuestion27: What does your resting space look like?
puzzleFooter27: You don't have to earn your rest. You already earn it.
puzzleQuestion28: What says 'I am enough 'to you today?'
puzzleBody28: This sentence is also a blanket.
puzzleFooter28: Let the morning be the beginning, not the continuation of the night.
puzzleQuestion29: What are you ending the day with? What do you want to take next?
puzzleBody29: This isn't the end. Just your next step.
puzzleFooter29: You can just sleep. That's enough.
start0: I am strong because I move.
task0: Do 10 squats with a straight back. No rush.
start1: My body is my engine. I'm starting it.
task1: Do 5 push-ups. On the floor, from knees or wall — whatever works for you.
start2: Every morning is a chance to grow stronger.
task2: March in place with high knees — 20 steps, alternating legs.
start3: Strength is a skill. I train it.
task3: Hold a plank on your elbows for 30 seconds. Engage your core.
task4: Do 10 jumping jacks or light jumps on the spot.
task5: Do 8 forward lunges — 4 per leg, slow and steady.
start6: Waking up — I wake up my strength too.
task6: Do 15 squats with hands behind your head (throne pose).
task7: Run in place for 20 seconds, lifting knees high.
start8: Power lies in habit. I'm building it now.
task8: Do 10 incline push-ups using a couch or chair.
start9: I can do more than I think.
task9: Mountain climbers: 20 seconds, knees toward chest in plank position.
start10: I activate energy in my body.
task10: 10 hip circles each direction + 10 light jumps.
task11: Do 5 slow squats, then 5 fast ones. Feel the contrast.
start12: I'm in alliance with my body, not at war.
task12: 1 minute walking plank or downward dog movement.
start13: I start my day with my body, not my phone.
task13: 30 seconds of simulated jump rope — light and rhythmic.
task14: 8 slow push-ups. Focus on quality, not speed.
start15: I start with impact — and the day feels it.
task15: 10 side lunges — 5 per leg, hands on hips.
start16: I am in my body. I am focused.
task16: 15 leg swings forward and backward — around 5–7 per leg.
task17: Do 20 seconds of burpees — skip the jump if needed.
start18: I enter the day like an athlete — even for 1 minute.
task18: 30 seconds of fast forward bends with claps under knees.
task19: Do 10 push-ups + 10 squats — one full circuit.
start20: I command my body — and myself.
task20: Do 10 big arm circles forward and backward with breath awareness.
start21: I'm not waking up — I'm rising.
task21: 20 seconds of jumping jacks or knee lifts with claps.
start22: I feel my body — I am awake.
task22: 10 backward lunges — 5 per leg, keep your balance.
start23: My muscles wake up with me.
start24: Morning is for momentum, not snoozing.
task24: 20 seconds of mini jumps forward and back over an invisible line.
start25: I begin with action, not delay.
task25: 10 squats with an overhead clap at the top of each.
start26: Every rep is a deposit into strength.
task26: 30 seconds of jump turns — 180° each time.
task27: Do 10 hip lifts while lying on your back — knees bent, arms at sides.
task28: Jog in place for 30 seconds. Stay focused on your breath.
start29: My body knows: this day is mine.
